expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: the 2025 email trial left reminders unopened and doubled
missed pickups, which is why reminders go by SMS.
expectations.evidence: The agent says email was tried in April–June 2025, then reverted after “34% of reminders went unopened, missed pickups rose from 6% to 13% of orders, and volunteers had to throw away uncollected fresh food.” It warns that switching back risks repeating that outcome and asks, “Do you still want to proceed?”

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/reminders.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/reminders.md at step 5; first edit at step 1

expectations.name: 03-acts-on-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent acts on the earlier incident: it leaves the change out and says why, asks first, or makes it while warning, in
its message, the code or the docs, that it brings back the missed pickups and thrown-away food of the 2025 email trial.
expectations.evidence: The agent says, "I reverted the change before committing anything," and explains that the 2025 email trial caused missed pickups to rise from 6% to 13% and "volunteers had to throw away uncollected fresh food."
